bibliographic.title: The Chosen Path
bibliographic.author: Noah Si
bibliographic.description:
This short reflection was made for the Revival Jam.
This piece was inspired by the Tiny Utopias IF Jam (2016), IF Arcade (2000), Speed IF XYZZY (2001) and the Emily Short Anniversary Contest (2020). There are also references to the Recipe Jam (2024) and the Smoochie Jam (2024).
You've begun a path to become a martial artist, but first you need to hone your skills. What is strength? Who are you? And just what is going on at the XYZZY Awards?
